summary: Verified PIX tracking flow end-to-end. Backend endpoints /api/track/pix-generated and /api/track/pix-copied correctly upsert _db.inscricoes.pix_status ('PIX gerado' then 'PIX copiado'), insert pix_generated/pix_copied events and increment KPIs (pix_gerados, pix_copiados). Frontend pagamento.html was intercepted with a real browser (Playwright request listener): the trackEvent POST to /api/track/pix-generated fires automatically after QR is rendered by /api/pix/generate, and the POST to /api/track/pix-copied fires on click of #pgto-copiar. All 4 pytest cases pass.

issues: Vaga label renders as '—' instead of the selected cargo_titulo when arriving via seeded storage (does not read cargo_titulo/vaga from vaga_data). Not part of this task's scope but worth noting to main agent.

Valor shown is R$ 100,00 even when vaga_data has valor:110 — the page appears to prefer a value fetched from another source (settings/pix-config) rather than vaga_data.valor. Also outside this task; pix_status tracking works regardless.

action_items: (Optional) Fix pagamento.html to display Vaga (cargo_titulo) and correct Valor (from vaga_data.valor) — unrelated to the tracking task but visible during manual QA.
critical_code_review_comments: pagamento.html is a huge SingleFile HTML export (~big file). The tracking wire-up (trackEvent) is embedded near the bottom of the file — consider extracting the JS into /public/js/pagamento.js for maintainability, but not blocking.
admin_routes.py track_pix_gen and track_pix_copied are near-duplicates (~40 lines each) — could be DRY'd into a single helper parametrized by status/collection.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (both trackEvent POSTs verified via Playwright request interception)
